purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 620 Faiyum (city code 3668); city-bound registry evidence and safe anonymous parcel-geometry route.

registryBasis: An official Egyptian Ministry of Finance directory search result lists the Faiyum Real Estate Publicity office and the Faiyum registration mission in Faiyum city. This establishes a local registration institution. The separate Egyptian Survey Authority page about a GIS unit in Faiyum concerns state-property inventory at governorate scope and is not treated as evidence of public city parcel coverage. No anonymous cadastral vector source was verified.
